units.source_text: 秀男家不是织和服料子，而是织腰带的。

en.t: Hideo's family did not weave kimono fabric; they wove obi sashes.

units.source_text: 有高机三台，白天也开亮电灯，安放织机的地方还算明亮，而且后面还有空地。

en.t: They had three tall looms, and even during the day they kept the electric lights on, so the place where the looms stood was fairly bright; there was also open space in the back.

units.source_text: 但房子很窄，甚至不知道家里人在什么地方休息、睡觉，不知道那些为数不多而且粗糙的厨具都放在哪里。

en.t: But the house was very cramped, so cramped that one could not even tell where the family rested or slept, or where they kept their few rough cooking utensils.
